mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a 20-day SPX return predictor remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or mean 20-day returns in low-rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating consumer spending power, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or mean returns in triggered periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 1200 thousand) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) indicates a demand shock that depresses corporate profit expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect fails to generate negative returns in >40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Recessionary GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.0%) reduces corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as risk appetite declines.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of recession periods (GDPC1 growth < 0.0%), or mean returns in recessions are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 158,000 thousand) boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a 5-day SPX return predictor is negative or below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or mean returns in triggered periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Aggressive monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals policy response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as stabilization expectations rise.
failure_condition: Interaction effect fails to produce positive returns in >40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of high-inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), or mean returns in high-inflation periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
